news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹7.76 (vs ₹5.46 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹7.76 (up from ₹5.46 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹3.62b (up 11% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹948.6m (up 42% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 26% (up from 20% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: AGI Infra Limited (BSE:539042) completed the acquisition of 60% stake in Worldnext Realty Llp.
news.body:
AGI Infra Limited (BSE:539042) agreed to acquire 60% stake in Worldnext Realty Llp for INR 300 million on August 28, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 300 million will be paid by AGI Infra Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Worldnext Realty Llp reported total revenue of INR 32.14 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer board. The deal has been approved by the board. The expected completion of the transaction is March 31, 2026.

AGI Infra Limited (BSE:539042) completed the acquisition of 60% stake in Worldnext Realty Llp on March 12, 2026.
